name: 용사의 힘 1단계
special_stat_rules: stage bonus granted on reaching the stage (main stat flat + Max HP %)
notes: Closest verified analogue of a rank system: each 용사의 힘 stage raises slot caps, adds slots and a stage bonus. Unlock: Guide Quest 79 (wiki/IV398). Global 1.14 (MSI) lists stages 1-8 with identical slot counts/caps.
